title: Bubble Tea Noodles in Coconut Milk (Lod Chong Singapore/Cendol)
ldName: Bubble Tea Noodles in Coconut Milk (Lod Chong Singapore/Cendol)
ldIngredientsRaw: 4.2 oz Pine Brand  tapioca starch plus extra for dusting (about 1 cup)
0.9 oz Pine Brand mung bean starch (about 3 Tbsp)
